faq.q: Do I need a shoot before I can make an electronics ad?
faq.a: No. Upload one photo of the speaker or paste a product link, name the press, and download the ad. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Do I need video editing experience?
faq.a: No. A spoken voice and captions come with the speaker clip, and you can fix them in the editor before you export.

faq.q: Can I make several versions of the same gadget?
faq.a: Yes. One speaker photo can become an unboxing, a button press, and a desk scene.

faq.q: Which electronics can I show from one photo?
faq.a: Speakers, cables, docks, and other gadgets with a clear shape. Use that product's own photo, and name one action, such as a button press or an unboxing.

faq.q: Can I make an electronics ad without hiring a creator?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one speaker photo or paste a link, pick an AI avatar, and pay the credits shown before the job. Post the clip as an ad.

faq.q: Will the clip state my battery life or wattage?
faq.a: Do not trust the picture for the numbers. Add battery life, watts, and which devices the cable fits in the listing or the editor, where you can check them.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid gadget ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in paid ads. Do not overstate how the speaker performs.

faq.q: What video shape should I pick?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone feed, 1:1 for a square, and 16:9 for a wide page. Use 4:3 or 3:4 when the page asks for them.

faq.q: Can the gadget ad include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Pick an AI avatar and the speaker clip can include a spoken line and captions.
